1.t: By the stars when they fade away

2.t: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray

3.t: Nor does he speak of his own whims

4.t: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺

5.t: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power

6.t: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form

7.t: while on the highest point above the horizon

8.t: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close

9.t: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less

10.t: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺

11.t: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw

12.t: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw

13.t: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time

14.t: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—

15.t: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—

16.t: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours

17.t: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach

18.t: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs
18.tr: Laqad ra-aa min aayaati Rabbihil kubraaa

19.t: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza

20.t: and the third one, Manât, as well

21.t: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters

22.t: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution

23.t: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
23.tr: In hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum Wa-aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; ien yattabi'oona illaz zanna Wa-maa tahwal anfusu Wa-laqad jaaa'ahum mir Rabbihimul hudaa

24.t: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire

25.t: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next

26.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves
26.tr: Wa-kam mim malakin fis samaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di aien yaazanal laahu limaien yashaaa'u Wa-yardaa

27.t: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female
27.tr: innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati la-yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa

28.t: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth
28.tr: Wa-maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin ien yattabi'oona illaz zanna Wa-innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa

29.t: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
29.tr: Fa-a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an zikrinaa Wa-lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa

30.t: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
30.tr: Zalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee-lihee Wa-huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa

31.t: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
31.tr: Wa-lillaahi maa fis samaawaati Wa-maa fil ardi liyajziyal lazeena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo Wa-yajziyal lazeena ahsanoo bilhusnaa

32.t: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous
32.tr: Allazeena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa-hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum iz ansha-akum minal ardi Wa-iz antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma-haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa

33.t: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺

34.t: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped

35.t: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺

36.t: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses
36.tr: Am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi Moosa

37.t: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺

38.t: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another

39.t: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards
39.tr: Wa-al laisa lil-insaani illaa maa sa'aa

40.t: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺

41.t: then they will be fully rewarded

42.t: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺

43.t: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness

44.t: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death

45.t: And He created the pairs—males and females—

46.t: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted

47.t: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation

48.t: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes

49.t: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius

50.t: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd

52.t: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression
52.tr: Wa-qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama Wa-atghaa

53.t: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down

55.t: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute

56.t: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones

58.t: None but Allah can disclose it
58.tr: Laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah

59.t: Do you find this revelation astonishing

60.t: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺

62.t: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺
